summary: Prudential plc furnished a Form 6-K reporting daily purchases of its own ordinary shares under buy-back arrangements with JP Morgan Securities plc announced 6 January 2026 and 2 September 2026. Over 26-30 October 2026 it bought roughly 3.26 million shares on XLON at volume-weighted prices of 8.8852 to 9.2469 GBP, with shares to be cancelled, leaving 2,462,720,570 shares and voting rights outstanding. Cumulatively, 91,237,315 shares have been repurchased at a 1,031.6143p VWAP. Watch execution pace, cancellation-driven EPS accretion, and any acceleration signals.
